specification.name: Quarterly claims
specification.about: The claims each program administrator files every quarter (and the statewide claims each statewide program's lead files), compiled into the claim year to date.

version.name: Starting version
version.summary: Generated from what the platform checks today: CEDARS' 2026 Claims specification as the platform carries it, with the fuel substitution infrastructure cost, claim site and withdrawal tables, and the two PII tables kept in the vault.
version.source: The claims module's layout (claims_2026.csv), the PII vault's tables, the claims rule set and the built-in checks

files: A .zip of delimited text files, one per table, named after the table
An Excel workbook with a sheet per table
file_format.encoding: UTF-8 (Windows-1252 is read where a file is not UTF-8)
file_format.names: Table and column names are matched without regard to letter case
file_format.column_order: Columns may be in any order
file_format.unknown_columns: A column the table does not have is ignored with a notice
file_format.unknown_files: A file or sheet that is not one of the tables is refused

fields.name: ClaimID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent record identifier and the primary key for the Claim table. Must match the corresponding ClaimID (previously CEInputID) in the Measure table. All values must start with the PA code and claim year in the format PA-YYYY.

fields.name: ParentClaimID
fields.definition: All values must start with the PA code and claim year in the format PA-YYYY.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent record identifier and the primary key for the Site table. Must match a SiteID in the Site table. All values must start with the PA code.

fields.name: ParticipantID
fields.definition: Identifier used by PAs to track all SEM activities and claims for a participant across the full program engagement, including core cycles and any graduate cycle. This ID is needed in tracking data to consistently link related SEM records over time (e.g., FPCx.00 or 7999.P0).

fields.name: ApplicationCode
fields.definition: A PA-specific code assigned to the incentive application.

fields.name: IETableName
fields.definition: Specifies the Ex Ante interactive effects table referenced.

fields.name: NAICSBldgType
fields.definition: The NAICS description of the business/facility where the measure was installed, e.g. Cotton Farming. Not used for residential measures.

fields.name: MeasTechID
fields.definition: ExAnte specific measure technology identifier.

fields.name: PrgElement
fields.definition: Program element or sub-program definition.

fields.name: ProjectDescription
fields.definition: Description of the project including enough information to allow understanding of the measure(s) being installed.

fields.name: ProjectID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent project identifier.

fields.name: WhySavingsZeroed
fields.definition: Clarifying comment or details on why a program has no savings.

fields.name: WhyCostsZeroed
fields.definition: Clarifying comment or details on why a program has no costs.

fields.name: Comments
fields.definition: Clarifying comments or details not included in the other data reporting fields.

fields.name: ClaimType
fields.definition: Either custom or deemed.

fields.name: FundingCycle
fields.definition: The program cycle that funded the measure.

fields.name: SEM_Phase
fields.definition: Indicates the program cycle (including Transition Year (T) and two years of the Grad Program (G)), reporting period, and program year from which SEM (Strategic Energy Management) savings are being claimed. Example: SEM Program Cycle 1, Reporting Period 1, SEM Program Year 1. This value is selected from the SEM_Phase list and replaces the previous SEM fields: SEM_ProgramCycle, SEM_ReportingPeriod, and SEM_ProgramYear.

fields.name: BldgLoc
fields.definition: Standard ExAnte Building Location/Climate Zone.

fields.name: BldgVint
fields.definition: Standard ExAnte Building Vintage.

fields.name: BldgHVAC
fields.definition: Standard ExAnte Building HVAC Type.

fields.name: DEER_MeasureID
fields.definition: DEER Measure ID referenced by implementation.

fields.name: DEER_Sector
fields.definition: Measure-level sector conforming to the Sectors listed in DEER.

fields.name: MeasImpactCalcType
fields.definition: Standard DEER type of measure impact calculation, e.g. Standard.

fields.name: InstalledNormUnit
fields.definition: Describes the normalization unit associated with the InstalledNumUnit (quantity) of the installed measure if different from the NormUnit associated with the NumUnit in the claim; This is descriptive and not used by the cost effectiveness calculator.

fields.name: CMPA_ApplicationID
fields.definition: The Application ID for the project reported to CMPA.

fields.name: CMPA_MeasureCode
fields.definition: The code for the measure reported to CMPA.

fields.name: MeasDetailID
fields.definition: The unique identifier of the eTRM permutation.

fields.name: TotalFirstYearGrosskW
fields.definition: Total first year gross kW savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalFirstYearGrosskWh
fields.definition: Total first year gross kWh savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalFirstYearGrossTherm
fields.definition: Total first year gross therm savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalFirstYearNetkW
fields.definition: Total first year net kW savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalFirstYearNetkWh
fields.definition: Total first year net kWh savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalFirstYearNetTherm
fields.definition: Total first year net therm savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalLifecycleGrosskW
fields.definition: Total life time gross kW savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalLifecycleGrosskWh
fields.definition: Total life time gross kWh savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalLifecycleGrossTherm
fields.definition: Total life time gross therm savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalLifecycleNetkW
fields.definition: Total life time net kW savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalLifecycleNetkWh
fields.definition: Total life time net kWh savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalLifecycleNetTherm
fields.definition: Total life time net therm savings to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalGrossMeasureCost
fields.definition: Total gross measure cost to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalGrossMeasureCost_ER
fields.definition: Total gross early retirement measure cost to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalGrossIncentive
fields.definition: Total gross incentive to be claimed.

fields.name: TotalCustomerInfrastructureCosts
fields.definition: Total customer infrastructure costs. Required for fuel sub.

fields.name: PartialPaymentPercent
fields.definition: The percent of payment associated with the incentives included in the claim record.

fields.name: WaterGallons
fields.definition: Water Energy Calculator gallons water savings used to calculate water energy savings.

fields.name: InstalledNumUnits
fields.definition: Quantity of the installed measure associated with the InstalledNormUnit if different from the NumUnit associated with the NormUnit in the claim. The CET does not use this field.

fields.name: OriginalMeterInstallYear
fields.definition: Year that the original meter was installed. Required for fuel sub.

fields.name: CCAREN_Flag
fields.definition: Community Choice Aggregator (CCA) and Regional Energy Network (REN). Flag to identify claims that had participation by a REN or CCA. For PAs who are a REN or CCA, this flag should be true for all claims.

fields.name: DAC_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify participation in an area designated as a disadvantaged community by the California Environmental Protection Agency (census tract). This indicates a geographic Hard-to-Reach (HTR) condition. Contributes to Hard-to-Reach (HTR) eligibility. Disadvantaged community participant counts are included in the Participant table.

fields.name: ElectricMasterMeter_Flag
fields.definition: Flag used to identify whether a site is a master metered multifamily residence for electric.

fields.name: ETP_Flag
fields.definition: Emerging Technology Program. Flag to identify that the measure is a product of an emerging techonology program.

fields.name: GasMasterMeter_Flag
fields.definition: Flag used to identify whether a site is a master metered multifamily residence for gas.

fields.name: HTR_Flag
fields.definition: Indicates the claim is being reported as Hard to Reach. The claim must satisfy one of the valid Hard to Reach qualification pathways. Hard to Reach participant counts are included in the Participant table.

fields.name: Lang_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify customers where the primary language spoken is other than English. Contributes to Hard-to-Reach (HTR) eligibility.

fields.name: NMEC_TU_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify whether the Claim represents a True-Up for a Normalized Metered Energy Consumption (NMEC) project. Set it to true if the Claim reflects adjusted savings based on post-implementation performance data.

fields.name: NRSize_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify projects at businesses with 25 or fewer employees, or annual electric demand is less than 20 kW, or annual gas usage is less than 10,000 therms. Contributes to Hard-to-Reach (HTR) eligibility.

fields.name: NRLease_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify measures that are installed at locations that are leased or rented. Contributes to Hard-to-Reach (HTR) eligibility.

fields.name: OBF_Flag
fields.definition: On Bill Financing. Flag to identify measures that had on-bill financing.

fields.name: OMBCSA_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify measures installed at customer premises located outside the United States Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Combined Statistical Areas of the San Francisco Bay Area, Greater Los Angeles Area, and Greater Sacramento Area, and outside the OMB metropolitan statistical area of San Diego County. This indicates a geographic Hard-to-Reach (HTR) condition. Contributes to HTR eligibility.

fields.name: PartialPaymentFinal_Flag
fields.definition: The claim is the final payment of a set of partial payments.

fields.name: PublicK_12_Flag
fields.definition: Public primary and secondary schools up to 12th grade. Flag to identify public K-12 schools

fields.name: ResLI_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify the residential customer meets the low-income definition through CARE or FERA eligibility. Contributes to Hard-to-Reach (HTR) eligibility.

fields.name: ResMFMH_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify residential multi-family homes and mobile/manufactured homes where tenants rent or lease the dwelling. Contributes to Hard-to-Reach (HTR) eligibility.

fields.name: Revised_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify that claim was revised since it was originally submitted.

fields.name: Underserved_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to indentify program is in an underserved community.

fields.name: CA_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify Cultural Accessibility. It identifies California Native American Tribes as hard to reach. Tribal customers qualify independently under Commission policy and do not need to meet additional Hard-to-Reach (HTR) criteria.

fields.name: LG_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify Local Government customer. Contributes to Hard-to-Reach (HTR) eligibility.

fields.name: ApplicationDate
fields.definition: Initiation date for a project or measure, e.g. contract date, application date, or program enrollment date.

fields.name: AuthorizedSignatureDate
fields.definition: The date the rebate/incentive was approved for payment

fields.name: CustomerAgreementDate
fields.definition: The date the agreement including the project specifics (measures and potential incentives) was signed/approved by both the customer and the IOU or their agents.

fields.name: ComplianceCertDate
fields.definition: The date the Title 24 building compliance certificate was issued. Only use for Deemed measures.

fields.name: InstallationDate
fields.definition: The date the project measure was installed, was operational and started providing savings.

fields.name: PaidDate
fields.definition: The date the cost has incurred.

fields.name: ProjectCompletionDate
fields.definition: The date the project, including all required internal and external verification and EM&V was completed.

fields.name: StartDate
fields.definition: From DeemedMeasure table. The first date that the implementation is to be referenced by claims. The start date for the relevant values from the referenced work paper.

fields.name: PermitIssuanceDate
fields.definition: The date the building permit was issued.

fields.name: ShipmentDate
fields.definition: The date the measure was shipped to the customer.

fields.name: SalesDate
fields.definition: The date the measure was purchased by the customer.

fields.name: ClaimID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent record identifier and the primary key for the Measure table. Must match the corresponding ClaimID in the Claim table. All values must start with the PA code and claim year in the format PA-YYYY. This field was previously called CEInputID.

fields.name: PrgID
fields.definition: The unique program identifier; joins to the ProgramCost table.

fields.name: ClaimYearQuarter
fields.definition: The year and quarter when the measure(s) were both installed and paid in e.g. '2023Q1'.

fields.name: Sector
fields.definition: Measure-level sector aligned to the program business plan sectors.

fields.name: DeliveryType
fields.definition: From DEER. Identifies program implementation strategy/method of delivering a measure to a customer (e.g. direct install).

fields.name: BldgType
fields.definition: From DEER. Text codes that identify the building type/use and other parameters specific to that building use.  For example, 'Com' = Commercial buildings.

fields.name: AC_Climate_Zone
fields.definition: The geographic area where the installation is completed. The CEC designates micro-climate and ranges from 1 - 16. Use 'System' if a program or measure installation is not specific to an area or city. Required for cost effectiveness calc; Must be compatible with CET values (e.g. '3A').

fields.name: AC_Gas_Impact_Profile
fields.definition: Used to profile typical period of use for gas appliances/measures. Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with gas savings (e.g. 'Summer Only', 'Winter Only', 'Annual').

fields.name: AC_Gas_Target_Sector
fields.definition: Used to determine how gas is purchased by the customer (e.g. 'Residential', 'Commercial', 'Core'). Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with gas savings.

fields.name: AC_Elec_Impact_Profile
fields.definition: Identifies the measure electric end use shape (i.e. load shape). Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with electric savings.

fields.name: AC_Elec_Target_Sector
fields.definition: Identifies the sector being targeted by the measure intervention. Required for cost effectiveness calculation for measures with electric savings.

fields.name: MeasAppType
fields.definition: From DEER. The measure application identifies the context for the measure's installation. (e.g. accelerated replacement, new construction or behavioral).

fields.name: MeasCode
fields.definition: PA-specific measure code.

fields.name: MeasDescription
fields.definition: Description of measure; should include enough information to allow understanding of what EE measure(s) being installed.

fields.name: MeasImpactType
fields.definition: From DEER. Describes how the savings impact was determined (e.g. Deemed-DEER, Deemed-Workpaper, Site-specific calculation, etc.).

fields.name: FuelID
fields.definition: This field references a CEDARS value list used to identify fuel substitution for Deemed measures. FuelID distinguishes exempt and non-exempt Deemed measure packages under the Viable Electric Alternative (VEA) framework established in D.23-04-035.

fields.name: MeasureID
fields.definition: Unique and persistent measure identifier.

fields.name: TechGroup
fields.definition: From DEER. All Technology Types in an end use are associated with a high-level Technology Group. For example, in the 'lighting' end use all screw-in lighting technologies, including compact fluorescent lamps (CFLs), light-emitting diodes (LEDs), and incandescent lamps are part of a Technology Group. All hard-wired lighting fixtures are part of a different Technology Group.

fields.name: TechType
fields.definition: From DEER. Technology Type is more specific than Technology Group. For example, a Technology Group can be further classified into individual parts. For example, all screw-in lighting technologies, including compact fluorescent lamps (CFLs), light-emitting diodes (LEDs), and incandescent lamps are included in the same Technology Group.

fields.name: UseCategory
fields.definition: From DEER. Describes the end use of the measure in broad terms  (e.g. HVAC, lighting, motors, refrigeration, process).

fields.name: UseSubCategory
fields.definition: From DEER. This is a more specific end use subcategory (e.g. the Lighting UseCategory contains Indoor General, Exit Signs, etc.).

fields.name: WaterUse
fields.definition: Water Energy Calculator water used to calculate water energy savings.

fields.name: PreDesc
fields.definition: Pre-existing measure description.

fields.name: StdDesc
fields.definition: Standard measure description.

fields.name: SourceDesc
fields.definition: The measure package ID for deemed measures.

fields.name: Version
fields.definition: The version of the work paper or DEER (e.g. 2013 Ex-Ante).

fields.name: NormUnit
fields.definition: Type of normalizing units, or basis of NumUnits or quantity used by the cost effectiveness calculation (e.g. 'Lamp', 'hp', 'tons', 'facility', etc.).

fields.name: NumUnits
fields.definition: Number of units or quantity. NumUnits must work in conjunction with the NormUnit value for the claim. Cross reference NormUnit and NumUnits before interpreting quantities of measures installed. This field is used in CEDARS cost and savings equations.

fields.name: UnitkW1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline kW Impact per Unit. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: UnitkWh1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline kWh Impact per Unit. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: UnitTherm1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline therm Impact per Unit. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: UnitkW2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline kW impact per unit for dual baseline measures. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: UnitkWh2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline kWh impact per unit for dual baseline measures. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: UnitTherm2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline therm impact per unit for dual baseline measures. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: UnitkWhIOUWater1stBaseline
fields.definition: The first baseline kWh impact per unit due to water savings.

fields.name: UnitkWhIOUWater2ndBaseline
fields.definition: The second baseline kWh impact per unit due to water savings.

fields.name: UnitMeaCost1stBaseline
fields.definition: This field is the installed measure cost. Incremental Measure Cost or Full Measure Cost for the first baseline period, as appropriate for the MeasAppType and DeliveryType. Incremental measure cost over Code/Std for single baseline measures. This field is not used for dual baseline Cost effectiveness calculations, except when calculating excess incentives (for single and dual baseline measures). This field is used in CEDARS cost equations.

fields.name: UnitMeaCost2ndBaseline
fields.definition: NPV gross measure cost based on first and second baseline measure costs. The Desktop CET called this field 'Gross Measure Cost_ER' (where ER = early retirement, aka accelerated replacement). This is the only measure cost field used for dual baseline CE calculations, except UnitMeaCost1stBaseline is used to calculate excess incentives (for single and dual baseline measures). This field is used in CEDARS cost equations.

fields.name: UnitDirectInstallLab
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost in dollars of installation labor. Enter the unit incentive for labor. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field; and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims, and is one of two incentive fields for Direct Install. Only use if a direct install. This field is used in CEDARS cost equations.

fields.name: UnitDirectInstallMat
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost in dollars of installation materials. Enter the unit incentive for materials. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field; and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims, and is one of two incentive fields for Direct Install. Only use if direct install. This field is used in CEDARS cost equations.

fields.name: UnitEndUserRebate
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost of rebates to the end user in dollars. Enter rebate to the customer for each unit of the measure. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field, and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims. Only use if downstream delivery type. This field is used in CEDARS cost equations.

fields.name: UnitIncentiveToOthers
fields.definition: This field is the actual cost in dollars of incentives to others besides the end user. Enter the incentive for others for each unit of measure. Cost effectiveness calculator uses this field; and overrides ExAnte values for deemed claims. Only use if midstream or upstream delivery type. Input should always be '0' for custom measures This field is used in CEDARS cost equations.

fields.name: NTG_ID
fields.definition: From DEER. The Ex Ante NTG_ID associated with the NTG values being claimed.

fields.name: NTGRkW
fields.definition: kW-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: NTGRkWh
fields.definition: kWh-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: NTGRTherm
fields.definition: Therm-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: NTGRCost
fields.definition: Cost-specific NTG value. Usually, there is one NTG value entered for all NTGR fields. Developed through evaluation studies. NTG describes the free-ridership that may be occurring within energy efficiency programs.

fields.name: EUL_ID
fields.definition: From DEER. Identifier from the EUL table which specifies the estimated useful life of the measure technology.

fields.name: EUL_Yrs
fields.definition: Effective useful life of EE measure in years.

fields.name: RUL_ID
fields.definition: From DEER. For dual baseline measures, specifies a row in the EUL table that identifies the remaining useful life of the existing technology.

fields.name: RUL_Yrs
fields.definition: For dual baseline measures, specifies the remaining useful life of pre-existing measure in years.

fields.name: GSIA_ID
fields.definition: Reference to the Ex Ante Gross Savings and Installation Adjustment table.

fields.name: RealizationRatekW
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor: kW weighted Realization rate for all measures included in this claim record. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: RealizationRatekWh
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor: kWh weighted Realization rate for all measures included in this claim record. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: RealizationRateTherm
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor: Therm weighted Realization rate for all measures included in this claim record. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: InstallationRatekW
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor, generally developed by evaluation studies of prior year programs. kW weighted installation rate for all measures included in the associated claim. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: InstallationRatekWh
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor, generally developed by evaluation studies of prior year programs. kWh weighted installation rate for all measures included in the associated claim. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: InstallationRateTherm
fields.definition: Ex ante adjustment factor, generally developed by evaluation studies of prior year programs. Therm weighted installation rate for all measures included in the associated claim. This field is used in CEDARS savings equations.

fields.name: Residential_Flag
fields.definition: The measure was installed in a residential setting.

fields.name: Upstream_Flag
fields.definition: The measure was delivered via an upstream delivery type, i.e. targeted the beginning of the supply chain (e.g. the manufacturer).

fields.name: IOU_AC_Territory
fields.definition: The utility avoided costs being used (PGE, SCE, SCG, SDGE). This field was previously called PA.

fields.name: UnitGasInfraBens
fields.definition: The unit benefits due to gas infrastructure savings.

fields.name: UnitRefrigCosts
fields.definition: The unit cost in dollars for refrigeration.

fields.name: UnitRefrigBens
fields.definition: The unit benefits due to refrigeration savings.

fields.name: UnitMiscCosts
fields.definition: The unit cost in dollars that is not captured in other cost fields.

fields.name: MiscCostsDesc
fields.definition: A description of the miscellaneous costs reported in the UnitMiscCosts field.

fields.name: UnitMiscBens
fields.definition: The unit benefits not captured in other benefit fields.

fields.name: MiscBensDesc
fields.definition: A description of the miscellaneous benefits reported in the UnitMiscBens field.

fields.name: UnitTaxCredits
fields.definition: Inflation Recovery Act tax incentives for energy, per unit. The CET sums UnitTaxCredits with other benefits in the TRC calculation where IRA-eligible measures apply.

fields.name: RateScheduleElec
fields.definition: CET field to specify measure-level electric rate schedule, overrides CET default. Used to differentiate between customer types and system average rates.

fields.name: RateScheduleGas
fields.definition: CET field to specify measure-level gas rate schedule, overrides CET default. Used to differentiate between customer types and system average rates.

fields.name: CombustionType
fields.definition: CET field that determines the rate of emission savings per MMBTU of reduced natural gas usage from gas conservation. Res Furnace is used as a default if there is no user selection. If not applicable or unknown, then leave the field blank.

fields.name: MeasInflation
fields.definition: CET field to specify measure-level inflation rate, overrides CET default.

fields.name: Comments
fields.definition: Text field for clarifying comments.

fields.name: PrgID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent program identifier. The ProgramCost primary key is PrgID and PrgYear in combination.

fields.name: PrgYear
fields.definition: The claim year. The ProgramCost primary key is PrgID and PrgYear in combination, must match the year in ClaimYearQuarter.

fields.name: ClaimYearQuarter
fields.definition: The year and claim quarter, e.g. '2023Q1'.

fields.name: AdminCostsOverheadAndGA
fields.definition: Program-level general administration costs and overhead.

fields.name: AdminCostsOther
fields.definition: Program-level other administration costs (not general administration or overhead).

fields.name: MarketingOutreach
fields.definition: Program-level marketing outreach costs.

fields.name: DIActivity
fields.definition: Direct implementation activity costs.

fields.name: DIInstallation
fields.definition: Direct implementation installation costs.

fields.name: DIHardwareAndMaterials
fields.definition: Direct implementation hardware and materials costs.

fields.name: DIRebateAndInspection
fields.definition: Direct implementation rebate and inspection costs.

fields.name: EMV
fields.definition: Program-level evaluation, measurement, and verification costs.

fields.name: UserInputIncentive
fields.definition: Program-level incentives and rebates.

fields.name: OnBillFinancing
fields.definition: Program-level on-bill financing.

fields.name: CostsRecoveredFromOtherSources
fields.definition: This field captures program-level energy efficiency (EE) activity costs that are recovered from ratepayers outside of the EE Public Purpose Program (PPP) budget, such as those covered by the General Rate Case (GRC). These costs are included to ensure accurate cost-effectiveness calculations but should not be confused with Integrated Demand-Side Management (IDSM) fields.

fields.name: PA
fields.definition: A program administrator code from the CEDARS PA list.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent record identifier and the primary key for the Site table. Must match a SiteID in the Claim table. All values must start with the PA code.

fields.name: SiteCity
fields.definition: The site city.

fields.name: SiteState
fields.definition: The site state, e.g. 'CA'.

fields.name: SiteZipCode
fields.definition: The site zip code.

fields.name: Residential_Flag
fields.definition: Flag to identify residential sites.

fields.name: NAICSCode
fields.definition: The site NAICS code (e.g. 112910).

tables.name: ContactClaim
tables.guidance: A claim's rows here replace all its earlier rows.

fields.name: ClaimID
fields.definition: The persistent record identifier that matches with a Claim.ClaimID. All values must start with the PA code and claim the year in the format PA-YYYY. Part of the ContactClaim table compound primary key - the ContactID and ClaimID in combination need to be unique.

fields.name: ContactID
fields.definition: The persistent record identifier that matches to the PII Contact table. All values must start with the PA code. Part of the ContactClaim table compound primary key - the ContactID and ClaimID in combination need to be unique.

fields.name: PrgID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent program identifier. The Participant primary key is PrgID, PrgYear, ParticipantType, and SiteID in combination.

fields.name: PrgYear
fields.definition: The claim year. The Participant primary key is PrgID, PrgYear, ParticipantType, and SiteID in combination.

fields.name: ParticipantType
fields.definition: The unique and persistent participant identifier. The Participant primary key is PrgID, PrgYear, ParticipantType, and SiteID in combination.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.definition: Identifies the specific site associated with the programs participant type. When populated, must match a valid Site.SiteID. If SiteID is null, the record applies to all sites for the given PrgID and ParticipantType. In this case, no records may exist for the same PrgID and ParticipantType with a populated SiteID. All values must begin with the PA code. The Participant primary key is PrgID, PrgYear, ParticipantType, and SiteID in combination.

fields.name: ParticipantCount
fields.definition: Total number of participants in the program.

fields.name: EquityTargeted
fields.definition: Number of participants qualifying as Equity Targeted. A program participant that meets the CPUC-adopted criteria for being Hard-to-Reach, or being located in a disadvantaged community, or considered underserved.

fields.name: DAC
fields.definition: Number of participants in a disadvantaged community as identified by census tracts.

fields.name: HTR
fields.definition: Number of participants qualifying as Hard-to-Reach.

fields.name: Underserved
fields.definition: Number of participants qualifying as underserved community.

fields.name: Comments
fields.definition: Clarifying comments or details not included in the other participant reporting fields.

tables.name: InfrastructureCost
tables.guidance: The fuel substitution infrastructure cost table: a claim's rows here replace all its earlier rows.

fields.name: ClaimID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent record identifier and the primary key for the Claim table. Must match the corresponding ClaimID (previously CEInputID) in the Measure table. All values must start with the PA code and claim year in the format PA-YYYY.

fields.name: MeasureID
fields.definition: Unique and persistent measure identifier.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent record identifier and the primary key for the Site table. All values must start with the PA code.

fields.name: PrgID
fields.definition: The unique and persistent program identifier.

fields.name: ElectricReplacedGas_Flag
fields.definition: Is the measure replacing gas? (ex: not mini split in a garage that was not conditioned).

fields.name: ExistingPanelSize
fields.definition: Amp size of the existing panel?

fields.name: ExistingPanelSlots
fields.definition: Number of circuit slots in existing panel?

fields.name: NewPanelSize
fields.definition: Amp size of the new panel?

fields.name: NewPanelSlots
fields.definition: Number of circuit slots in new panel?

fields.name: InfrastructureUpgradesRequired
fields.definition: Is an upgrade of the panel, wiring, or outlets (or any combination of those) required for the fuel substitution measure?

fields.name: OtherInfrastructureUpgradesRequired
fields.definition: Are any other infrastructure upgrades (ex: sub panel, split circuit, etc.) required for the fuel substitution measure?

fields.name: PanelLaborCost
fields.definition: Labor cost of panel upgrade.

fields.name: PanelEquipCost
fields.definition: Equipment cost of panel upgrade.

fields.name: WiringLaborCost
fields.definition: Labor cost of wiring upgrade.

fields.name: WiringEquipCost
fields.definition: Equipment cost of wiring upgrade.

fields.name: OutletLaborCost
fields.definition: Labor cost of outlet upgrade.

fields.name: OutletEquipCost
fields.definition: Equipment cost of outlet upgrade.

fields.name: OtherInfraLaborCost
fields.definition: Labor cost of other infrastructure upgrades.

fields.name: OtherInfraEquipCost
fields.definition: Equipment costs of other infrastructure upgrades.

fields.name: TotalInfraLaborCost
fields.definition: The total labor cost of any and all infrastructure upgrades completed as part of the fuel substitution measure installation.

fields.name: TotalInfraEquipCost
fields.definition: The total equipment cost of any and all infrastructure upgrades completed as part of the fuel substitution measure installation.

fields.name: TotalCost
fields.definition: The total cost (labor and equipment) of any and all infrastructure upgrades completed as part of the fuel substitution measure installation.

fields.name: OtherElectrificationMeasures
fields.definition: Are any other electrification measures being installed at the same time as the EE fuel substitution measure (EV charging, etc.)?

fields.name: BldgBuiltYear
fields.definition: Year building was built.

fields.name: AC_Flag
fields.definition: Does the building have AC?

fields.name: ConditionedSqFt
fields.definition: What is the square footage of the air conditioned space in the building that will be conditioned by the new fuel substitution measure?

fields.name: InfraCustomerRequestDate
fields.definition: If infrastructure was upgraded, when did the customer begin seeking the upgrade?

fields.name: InfraCustomerCompleteDate
fields.definition: If infrastructure was upgraded, when was the upgrade completed?

fields.name: GasPipeCappingCost
fields.definition: The cost of capping off or removing any gas pipes or flues.

fields.name: SourceNonEEDollars
fields.definition: The program(s) name(s) of any Federal (ex: IRA) or other state programs (ex: TECH) that provided any monetary support (ex: incentives or rebates) for the fuel substitution measure.

fields.name: TotalNonEEDollars
fields.definition: The total dollar value of any Federal (ex: IRA) or other state programs (ex: TECH) that provided any monetary support (ex: incentives or rebates) for the fuel substitution measure.

tables.name: ClaimSite
tables.guidance: The sites of a claim that covers more than one (population NMEC): a claim's rows here replace all its earlier rows.

fields.name: ClaimID
fields.definition: The claim: a population NMEC claim (or any claim that covers more than one site) lists each of its sites here, beyond the Claim record's own SiteID. A claim's rows replace all of its earlier rows.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.definition: A site the claim covers. Must match a SiteID in the Site table.

tables.name: Withdrawal
tables.guidance: Names the claims an upload withdraws and why. A withdrawn claim keeps its records with a withdrawn status.

fields.name: ClaimID
fields.definition: The claim withdrawn: a ClaimID filed earlier in the claim year. Its records stay in the year's history, marked withdrawn, and are no longer priced or counted.

fields.name: WithdrawalReason
fields.definition: Why the claim is withdrawn. Shown with the claim in the submission history and on the change letter.

fields.name: WithdrawnIn
fields.definition: Filled in by CEDARS, not by the PA: the confirmation and version that withdrew the claim.

tables.name: PII_Contact
tables.guidance: Kept in the PII vault and uploaded on its own page, never with the claim tables (a file of this table in a claims upload refuses the upload). Findings name the key and the field, never the value.

tables.name: PII_Site
tables.guidance: Kept in the PII vault and uploaded on its own page, never with the claim tables (a file of this table in a claims upload refuses the upload). Findings name the key and the field, never the value.

checks.finds: The table lacks a column the template requires (for Measure and ProgramCost, a column of the claims specification, so their rules were not run).
checks.fix: Add the column (it may be blank).

checks.tables: Tables the claims rule set does not cover
checks.finds: A required field is blank.
checks.fix: Fill in the field.

checks.tables: Tables the claims rule set does not cover
checks.finds: A value is not of the field's type (a number, a date, a flag, a year and quarter) or is too long.
checks.fix: Enter the value in the field's type, as the template describes it.

checks.tables: Tables keyed by their own records
checks.finds: Two records of the table have the same key.
checks.fix: Keep one record per key; to correct a record, change it in place.

checks.finds: A ClaimID does not start with the PA code and claim year (or SW and the year), or a SiteID with the PA code (or SW).
checks.fix: Start each ClaimID with the PA code and claim year, for example PGE-2027-0001, and each SiteID with the PA code.

checks.finds: ClaimYearQuarter is not a quarter of the claim year up to this upload's quarter, or PrgYear is not the claim year.
checks.fix: Use the claim year's quarters up to this one; later claims go in their own quarter's upload.

checks.finds: PrgID is not in the program registry.
checks.fix: Use the PrgID of a program in the Programs catalog, or ask for the program to be added first.

checks.finds: A statewide program in a PA's own claims, or a program that is not statewide in the statewide claims filing.
checks.fix: Statewide programs are claimed by their lead PA in the statewide claims filing; claim the PA's own programs in its own claims.

checks.finds: The program is not one the filing PA may claim.
checks.fix: Claim only your own programs and the statewide programs you lead.

checks.tables: Measure, Claim, ClaimSite, Participant and the tables keyed by claim
checks.finds: A record names a claim, site or program record that the year to date does not have: a measure without its claim or its program's ProgramCost record, a claim without its measure, a site without its Site record.
checks.fix: Add the missing record (in this upload or an earlier confirmed quarter's).

checks.finds: A withdrawal of a claim not filed this year or already withdrawn, or records filed for a claim that is withdrawn.
checks.fix: Withdraw a confirmed claim once and leave its records as they were filed; file it again under a new ClaimID.

checks.finds: A true-up's parent is the claim itself, a claim the PA has not filed, a withdrawn claim or one of its own true-ups (reject), or not a NMEC claim (warning).
checks.fix: Give the ClaimID of the claim the true-up adjusts.

checks.finds: The site is not in California, its ZIP code is not a California ZIP code, or a non-residential site has no NAICS code.
checks.fix: Enter CA, the site's five-digit California ZIP code and, for a non-residential site, its NAICS code.

checks.finds: A NMEC true-up has no ParentClaimID, or a NMEC claim has no NMEC_TU_Flag.
checks.fix: Give the claim the true-up adjusts, and enter 1 or 0 in NMEC_TU_Flag.

checks.finds: A SEM claim lacks its ParticipantID or SEM_Phase, or SEM_Phase is filled in on a claim that is not SEM.
checks.fix: Fill in both on a SEM claim (MeasImpactType Cust-SEM or Cust-SEM-FuelSub), and leave SEM_Phase blank otherwise.

checks.finds: A deemed claim lacks its MeasDetailID, ProjectID or MeasImpactCalcType.
checks.fix: Fill in the field: deemed claims need it.

checks.finds: A fuel substitution claim has no TotalCustomerInfrastructureCosts.
checks.fix: Enter the customer's infrastructure costs (0 if there were none) and add its InfrastructureCost record.

checks.finds: PartialPaymentPercent is not between 0 and 1, or is blank on a final partial payment.
checks.fix: Enter the share paid as a fraction, for example 0.5 for half.

checks.finds: CCAREN_Flag is not 1 on a claim filed by a CCA or REN.
checks.fix: Enter 1: every claim a CCA or REN files has it.

checks.fields: MeasDetailID, the values eTRM gives a permutation, ClaimYearQuarter
checks.finds: A deemed claim's MeasDetailID is not a permutation of its measure in eTRM, or a value differs from eTRM's (reject; a few fields only warn); or the measure version is not in the eTRM data yet, or the permutation is not in effect in the claim's quarter (warning).
checks.fix: Enter eTRM's value or leave it blank to have it filled in, and give the MeasDetailID of the permutation installed.

checks.finds: The claims rule set in force could not be applied, so the version cannot be called valid.
checks.fix: Tell the CPUC's CEDARS support; the file may be fine.

checks.fields: A field whose codes come from a value list made for the specification
checks.finds: The value is not a code of the value list, or not one accepted for the record's year.
checks.fix: Use a code from the value list that is accepted for the year (the list's page shows each code's first and last year).

checks.finds: The record's key is blank.
checks.fix: Fill in the ContactID or SiteID.

checks.finds: The key does not start with the PA's code.
checks.fix: Start each ContactID and SiteID with your PA code.

checks.finds: The same key is on two records.
checks.fix: Keep one record per key.

checks.finds: No ContactClaim or Site record of the claim names this key.
checks.fix: Use the ContactIDs and SiteIDs the claim's ContactClaim and Site records name.

checks.finds: A value is longer than the field allows.
checks.fix: Shorten the value to the field's length in the template.

checks.fields: The phone number and extension fields
checks.finds: A phone number has characters other than digits.
checks.fix: Write phone numbers as digits only.

checks.finds: An email address has no @.
checks.fix: Correct the email address.

checks.finds: Neither an electric nor a gas service account is filled in for the site.
checks.fix: Fill in at least one of the two.
